definition{
  name: respondText,
  parameters: [body : String],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if (16384 <? (prim length (prim utf8_encode body : Bytes) : Nat)) then (prim utf8_encode "status error\nresponse too-large" : Bytes) else (prim utf8_encode body : Bytes))
}

definition{
  name: respond,
  parameters: [lines : (List String)],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (respondText (prim join lines "\n" : String)),
  axioms: [propext]
}

definition{
  name: dispatchText,
  parameters: [text : String],
  result: String,
  body: (match (prim split_exact text "\n" (4097 : UInt32) : (Option (List String)))
    | Option.none => "status error\nrequest too-many-lines"
    | Option.some lines => (match lines
      | List.nil => "status error\nline 1 missing-header"
      | List.cons header body => (if (prim equal header "dataflow-policy/1" : Bool) then (Engine::outcomeText (Engine::conclude (Engine::runLines body (Core::emptyProject) (1 : UInt32)))) else "status error\nline 1 missing-header"))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: textDispatch,
  parameters: [request : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if ((prim length request : Nat) =? 0) then (respond (cons "status error" (cons "request empty" (nil String)))) else (if (4096 <? (prim length request : Nat)) then (respond (cons "status error" (cons "request too-large" (nil String)))) else (match (prim utf8_decode request : (Option String))
    | Option.none => (respond (cons "status error" (cons "request invalid-utf8" (nil String))))
    | Option.some text => (respondText (dispatchText text))))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: dispatch,
  parameters: [request : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match (prim utf8_decode request : (Option String))
    | Option.none => (textDispatch request)
    | Option.some text => (match (Frame::unframe text)
      | Option.none => (textDispatch request)
      | Option.some framed => (Frame::answer framed (textDispatch (prim utf8_encode (project framed payload) : Bytes))))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]
}
